decision.reason: [ev-4407ed95f094] is a one-line note saying only that support for clusterLocal host exclusions in multi-cluster was "Fixed". It doesn't say how exclusions behaved before the fix, how they behave now, or whether anything visible changes for an environment that uses them. Without that, I can't tell whether the consequence is behavior-change or none, and the proposed statement goes further than the text supports. To decide, we need the linked PR/issue (52367) or an upgrade note that describes the behavior before and after the fix.
